title: In This Town Your Shadow Stays Where You're HAPPIEST
description:
In this town, nobody's shadow stays under them. It goes and sits wherever they were happiest. Mine has never once left my feet.

Dad has run the crazy golf in the park for thirty years, and on Sunday it shuts. Every evening he putts round alone, then sits by the last shadow left on the last green. On Thursday, his bench is empty.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Where would your shadow be sitting right now?
hold: the narrator is drawn as a woman, but the one narrator voice is a man's (RULES: the narrator is a man or teen boy)
